HidTools.Title: HID
HidTools.Description: The report layout the HID class driver read from the device, its input as it arrives, and its feature and output reports.
HidTools.Status.NoCollections: Windows has made no HID collection of this function.
HidTools.Reach.LayoutOnly: Windows keeps this one to itself — keyboards and mice deliver their input only to the desktop — so its input cannot be watched here. Its layout and feature reports can.
HidTools.Reach.ReadOnly: Windows lets Nexaflow read this collection but not send to it.
HidTools.Reach.NoWrite: This collection does not take reports from Nexaflow.
HidTools.HexTip: The report in hex, its ID first — e.g. 02 01 00
HidTools.Confirm.Title: Send a {0}
HidTools.Confirm.Message: Send the {0} {1} to {2}? A device can do anything with a report it is sent — change a setting, light an LED, restart.
HidTools.Hex.Empty: Type the report's bytes in hex first.
HidTools.Hex.NotHex: That is not hex: use pairs of 0–9 and A–F, such as 02 01 FF.
